payload.domain: baseline characterization of laminar lid-driven cavity flows

chosen_hypothesis.rationale: D.0 CANNED (not stage-1 output): a synthetic cavity-shaped stage-5 input; the proof is assembly determinism, not physical realism.

experiment_spec.title: Baseline cavity mean-speed characterization
experiment_spec.objective: Characterize the volume-averaged flow speed of the baseline lid-driven cavity at two lid speeds, as an executable end-to-end proof of verdict-gated simulation with real QoI extraction.

qoi.name: mean_flow_speed
qoi.definition: Volume-averaged velocity magnitude over the whole cavity at the final simulated time.
qoi.how_extracted: Single-QoI extraction per the substrate contract: volAverage of mag(U) at the latest written time.

success_criterion.statement: The volume-averaged flow speed at lid_velocity 2.0 m/s exceeds 0.3 m/s.

regime.notes: Steady laminar recirculating lid-driven cavity; Re = U*L/nu spans 100 (lid 1.0) to 200 (lid 2.0), inside the substrate's validated envelope.

mini_experiment.expected_observation: Both runs converge; the mean flow speed at lid 2.0 m/s is roughly twice that at lid 1.0 m/s (linear laminar scaling), near 0.42 m/s vs near 0.21 m/s.

full_experiment.design: The two mini-experiment runs ARE the experiment: a two-point lid-speed characterization of the baseline cavity.

fidelity_verdict.label: trust
fidelity_verdict.rationale: D.0 canned executable baseline for the stage-5 input fixture
